learning_outcomes.text: Provide educational information about medical equipment.
Introduce materials used in patient care in hospitals.
Provide the ability to think analytically about problems that may arise in complex medical equipment.

syllabus_topics: Brief introduction to anatomy and physiology.
Origin of biopotentials, electrical activity of excitable cells, action potentials, membrane models.
Origin of biopotentials: ECG, EMG, EEG, MEG, etc.
Measurement of blood flow and pressure.
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan; they are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
